COLLABORATION AREAS
:::

Climate and environmental psychology; psychological counselling and education; digital behaviour and emotion regulation; and sport and performance psychology.

Methodologically, I am particularly interested in systematic review and meta-analysis, cross-cultural and multilevel analysis, and R-based reproducible research workflows.
